admin.quiet.title: Quiet-time cadence
admin.roles_independent_hint: Independent — a resident may hold any combination. Nothing checked = a plain Member.
admin.moderator_scope_hint: The communities this account may moderate. Meaningful only when the Moderator role is checked — the platform clears the scope picks when the Moderator role is off.
admin.flash_mandatory_forbidden: You are not permitted to set a community as mandatory.
admin.flash_mandatory_standing_forbidden: You are not permitted to set a community's mandatory standing.
admin.flash_community_user_add_forbidden: You are not permitted to add a community user.
admin.flash_community_user_remove_forbid: You are not permitted to remove a community user.
admin.flash_moderator_set: User is now a moderator of the community.
admin.flash_moderator_set_forbidden: You are not permitted to set a community moderator.
admin.flash_moderator_unset: User no longer moderates the community.
admin.flash_moderator_unset_forbidden: You are not permitted to unset a community moderator.
admin.flash_not_permitted: You are not permitted to perform this action.
admin.flash_account_verified: Account verified. It can now sign in.
admin.flash_verify_forbidden: You are not permitted to verify this account.
admin.flash_block_self: You cannot block your own account. Have another GlobalAdmin perform this, or use a different admin account.
admin.flash_account_blocked: Account blocked. It has no standing until unblocked.
admin.flash_block_forbidden: You are not permitted to block this account.
admin.flash_account_unblocked: Account unblocked. Its standing is available again.
admin.flash_unblock_forbidden: You are not permitted to unblock this account.
admin.flash_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account through this surface. Use your own Delete account settings page instead.
admin.flash_account_deleted: Account deleted. Their audit trail is preserved (pseudonymized); their account, profile, and memberships are removed.
admin.flash_delete_forbidden: You are not permitted to delete this account.
admin.flash_breakglass: Break-glass elevation activated. It lasts until its expiry; every privileged decision under it is audited with via:BreakGlass.
admin.flash_date_format_set: Platform default date & time format set to “{0}”.
admin.flash_timezone_set: Platform default time zone set to “{0}”.
admin.flash_help_reset: Page reset to its seeded text.
admin.flash_quiet_range: The cadence must be between 5 and 1440 minutes.
admin.flash_site_home_saved: The home page's hero text and section toggles have been saved.
admin.flash_site_about_saved: The about page's hero text and section toggles have been saved.
admin.flash_site_palette_saved: The platform's default palette has been saved.
admin.flash_translation_needs_hero: A translation needs at least one hero field.
admin.flash_storage_file_limit: The per-file limit must be a whole number of MiB, or left blank for the platform default.
admin.flash_storage_user_quota: The per-user quota must be a whole number of MiB (0 for unlimited).
admin.flash_labels_saved: The surface labels have been saved.
admin.flash_translation_needs_label: A translation needs at least one surface label.
admin.hub.lede: One neighborhood, instance-wide: accounts, communities, platform settings, and the security surfaces. Pick a section below.
admin.status.title: Instance status
admin.status.lede: A read-only view of this instance's health and configuration: the database, the mail relay, the mail alarm, the byte store, and the running build. Read-only: this page writes nothing.
admin.status.warnings.title: Configuration warnings
admin.status_notice.text: This instance has configuration or health warnings.
admin.status.warning.seedadmin_still_set: The one-time setup credentials (SeedAdmin__Email / SeedAdmin__Token) are still set even though a GlobalAdmin already exists. Remove them (see first-boot step 4).
admin.status.warning.sampledata_in_produ: The sample-data seeder (SampleData__Enabled) is on in a real (Production) deployment. Real deployments omit it.
admin.status.warning.health_token_unset: Health__Token is unset — the full /health diagnostic payload is reachable without a shared secret. Set one for production.
admin.status.warning.dataprotection_not_: DataProtection__KeysDirectory is not persisted — sign-in and antiforgery state is in-memory and is lost on every redeploy. Point it at a persistent directory.
admin.hub.status_desc: This instance's health and configuration — database, mail relay, mail alarm, byte store, and the running build. Read-only.
admin.hub.accounts_desc: The account list, the verify queue, and per-account roles, scope, and standing.
admin.hub.communities_desc: Add, edit, enable/disable, and set the mandatory standing of the neighborhood's feeds.
admin.hub.platform_desc: Languages, time zone, date & time format, sign-up, and the five shipped platform pages.
admin.hub.security_desc: The access audit log and the break-glass elevation path.
admin.hub.storage_desc: How full the byte store is, how much is resident content, and the space used per user. Read-only.
admin.hub.storage_settings_desc: The community's upload limits — per-file size cap, per-user content quota, and total usage.
admin.hub.anncomments_desc: Whether signed-in residents may comment on announcements.
admin.hub.messaging_desc: Whether signed-in residents may open direct 1:1 conversations (off by default).
admin.hub.portability_desc: Export the whole instance as one archive, or restore an archive into this instance.
admin.hub.escalation_desc: Configure the operator escalation endpoint and the tokens other platforms present to escalate issues to this instance.
admin.hub.guests_desc: Settle the bounded window and allowed surfaces for a guest (a limited, time-bounded standing outside the resident circle).
admin.platform.lede: Instance-wide management — the platform's languages and translated UI strings, the default time zone and date & time format, the sign-up gate, the notification-flush cadence, the access audit log, and the break-glass elevation path.
admin.platform.languages_desc: Which languages the platform supports, and the translated UI strings and static pages.
admin.platform.timezone_desc: The platform-default time zone residents' timestamps fall back to when they set no preference.
admin.platform.dateformat_desc: The platform-default date & time format for residents' timestamps.
admin.platform.signup_desc: Whether new residents may create an account on their own — close it for invitation-only sign-up.
admin.platform.site_desc: Edit the landing surfaces' hero text and choose which sections are shown on the home and about pages.
admin.platform.labels_desc: Rename the top-navigation surfaces (Home, Announcements, Community, Groups, and the "More" menu items) — the nav and each surface's page header follow the choice. A blank field keeps the default label.
admin.platform.help_desc: Reset the seeded platform help pages — per page, or every page at once — back to their shipped text.
admin.platform.quiet_desc: How often held notification emails are re-checked and delivered — residents set their own quiet window on /settings/quiet.
admin.platform.breakglass_desc: The one-time elevation path for emergencies.
admin.platform.sample_desc: This instance runs the demo neighborhood. Lock the sample accounts out of changing their own password so visitors can test features without breaking the shared credentials.
admin.platform.pages_desc: The five pages a fresh instance ships with. "Preview" opens the page as residents see it; "Edit" opens the page editor (admins only). "About" is the product story — preview only.
admin.communities.empty: No communities yet. Use the form above to add the first one.
admin.communities.no_members: No explicit members — add one below.
admin.communities.mandatory_tip: Everyone in the neighborhood is a member — no one can be removed or leave it.
admin.communities.moderator_scope_tip: Standing moderator scope is ON for this community.
admin.accounts.delete_confirm: Delete this account permanently? Their audit trail is preserved (pseudonymized). This cannot be undone.
admin.manage.storage_quota_no_override: No override set — this account uses the community default. Set one to give this account more (or less) space without changing everyone’s.
admin.manage.storage_override_active: This account has its own quota override.
admin.manage.storage_quota_hint: Blank = use the community default. 0 = unlimited for this account. A whole number of MiB = this account’s cap. Saving only changes this account — the community-wide quota is untouched.
admin.flash_storage_override_invalid: The quota override must be a whole number of MiB, 0 for unlimited, or left blank to use the community default.
admin.flash_storage_override_cleared: Quota override cleared — this account uses the community default.
admin.manage.delete_confirm: Delete this account permanently? Their audit trail is preserved (pseudonymized); their account, profile, and memberships are removed. This cannot be undone.
admin.security.lede: The security surfaces — the always-on access-decision log and the one-time break-glass elevation path. Both are their own pages; this is the section hub.
admin.security.breakglass_desc: The one-time elevation path for emergencies — consume an operator-written token to act with elevated standing for a bounded window.
admin.breakglass.no_code: No break-glass code has been set up for your account. Ask the operator to set one up before using this page.
admin.breakglass.once_active: Once activated, the elevation stays in effect until its own expiry; every privileged action taken under it is written to the audit log (see the audit log). This page will not let you activate the same code twice.
admin.site.lede: The copy and sections of the two landing surfaces — the home page (/) and the about page (/about). Change the hero text, or hide a section on either page. Save each page separately; saving one does not touch the other.
admin.site.appearance_desc: The platform's default colour palette. Members see it until they pick their own from the account menu, and it helps people who belong to several platforms tell this one apart. Light/dark mode stays each member's choice.
admin.site.palette_hint: Each card shows the palette in light (left) and dark (right).
admin.site.home_desc: The hero eyebrow and lead, and which of the home page's sections are shown. A hidden section is removed from the page entirely — visitors and screen readers never see it.
admin.site.hero_scope_hint: The first supporting line under the hero lead ("Kumunita started out as…").
admin.site.hero_fig_hint: The second supporting line under the hero lead ("It is built on the Fractal Integration Guidelines…").
admin.site.show_about_link: Show the hero's link to the about page.
admin.site.show_hero_cards: Show the hero band and the feature cards together. Hiding them also hides the hero's eyebrow and lead.
admin.site.show_roadmap: Show the roadmap of what the platform ships next.
admin.site.about_desc: The hero eyebrow and lead, and which of the about page's sections are shown. A hidden section is removed from the page entirely.
admin.site.show_feature_cards: Show the three cards describing what the platform is.
admin.site.show_philosophy_band: Show the FIG-philosophy band (Fair, Invisible, Generous).
admin.site.show_code_docs: Show the links to the project's code and documentation.
admin.site.show_recent_changes: Show the list of recent changes.
admin.site.translations_desc: Translate the two heroes' eyebrow and lead — and the home hero's two supporting lines — into a resident's language. Use the language chips to preview each version, and the ⋮ menu to add a translation (if a language is missing), edit one (if it exists), or remove it. A resident reading the site in that language sees the translated text on / and /about; any field left blank falls back to the English text saved above.
admin.storage.lede: The community's upload limits: the per-file size cap and the per-user content quota, and how much resident content is in use.
admin.storage.file_limit_hint: Leave blank to use the platform default; 0 = unlimited file size.
admin.storage.quota_unlimited: Per-user quota is unlimited — residents have no total-content cap. Set a quota to cap each resident's total uploaded content.
admin.labels.lede: The display name of each top-navigation surface — what residents see in the top nav and in that surface's page header. Leave a field blank to keep the default label (the platform's shipped name for that surface). Saving applies every field at once; a rename stays consistent across the surface (the nav and the page header always agree).
admin.labels.translations_desc: Translate the surface labels into a resident's language. A resident reading the platform in that language sees the translated labels in the nav and in each surface's page header; any surface left blank falls back to the value saved above (then to the platform's shipped name). Save a translation separately — it does not touch the English labels above.
admin.labels.add_hint: Leave a surface blank to keep that surface in the language of the labels saved above. At least one surface is required.
admin.help.lede: The platform help pages the platform ships with seeded text. Each one is flagged when the code carries newer text than what is stored here — apply a reset to bring a page (or every page) back to its seeded baseline.
admin.guests.lede: The limited, time-bounded standing an admin settles for a guest (a consultant, coach, teacher, speaker, or similar outside-the-resident-circle account). A guest is never a full member: they see only the surfaces you allow, for the window you set.
admin.guests.subject_hint: Pick the account the guest signs in with. One allowance document per guest account.
admin.guests.window_hint: The standing is live from the From time up to, but not including, the Until time — a guest outside that window has no standing.
admin.guests.no_surfaces: No surfaces selected — the guest signs in to a shell with no gated content (the least-privileged floor, not an error).
admin.storagemetrics.lede: A read-only view of the media byte store: how full the volume is, how much is resident content, and the space used per user. A point-in-time snapshot — no history, and no export in this version. Read-only: this page writes nothing.
admin.setup.title: Complete first-boot setup
admin.setup.lede: Entering your setup token sets the first admin’s password and signs you in. This one-time handoff is the only way to activate the seed account.
admin.quiet.lede: How often the notification-flush job re-checks the held (deferred) emails — a quiet resident's email is held until their quiet hours end, then released on the next check. Residents set their own quiet window on /settings/quiet; this only sets how often the held ones are re-checked.
admin.quiet.range_hint: Valid range is 5–1440 minutes. A missing value floors to the instance default of 60 minutes.
admin.portability.lede: The whole instance as one portable archive — the content, the media, the identity graph (without the credential material), and the settings. Export it as a *.kumunita file, or restore an existing archive into this instance.
admin.portability.export_desc: One *.kumunita archive — the content, the media, the identity graph (never the credential material), and the instance settings.
admin.portability.import_desc: Restore a *.kumunita archive into this instance. By default the import replaces this instance's state — keep a pre-import backup; residents re-authenticate after the restore (passwords are reset). Tick the option below to keep the existing accounts and content and only add what is new.
admin.breakglass.explainer: A break-glass elevation is set up by the operator outside the app, not by any button on this page. This page only activates the one-time code the operator has already set up. Using it is a one-time action: once you present the code it cannot be used again, and the elevation ends on its own at its expiry time.
admin.security.audit_desc: A record of who was allowed or denied access to restricted content, plus admin actions. Filter by actor, via, or outcome.
admin.site.hint_add: Leave a field blank to keep that hero in the English text saved above. At least one field is required.
admin.site.hint_edit: Leave a field blank to revert that hero to the English text saved above. At least one field is required.
admin.timezone_lede: The time zone residents' timestamps fall back to when they have set no personal preference of their own.
admin.dateformat_lede: The date & time format residents' timestamps fall back to when they have set no personal preference of their own.
admin.dateformat_custom_hint: A .NET custom datetime format string (e.g. yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm). Leave blank to use a preset.
admin.signup_lede: Whether new residents may create an account on their own. Closing the gate makes sign-up invitation-only — existing residents are unaffected.
admin.signup_invitation_only: Invitation-only — new self-service accounts are gated
admin.signup_notify_lede: When a new resident signs up and when a resident verifies their account, the GlobalAdmins get an inbox notification and a best-effort email. Turning it off silences that — the account lane itself is unaffected.
admin.signup_notify_on: On — admins are notified of new sign-ups and verifications
admin.signup_notify_off: Off — no admin notifications on sign-up / verification
admin.signup_resident_invite_lede: Whether signed-in residents may create invitations for neighbours (the “Invite a neighbour” surface). A fresh instance ships with this off — resident invite is opt-in, set here by a GlobalAdmin. The admin invitation surface is always available to GlobalAdmins, regardless of this setting.
admin.signup_resident_invite_on: On — residents can invite neighbours (immediately usable)
admin.signup_resident_invite_on_approval: On with admin approval — a GlobalAdmin must approve each resident invitation before it becomes usable
admin.anncomments_lede: Whether signed-in residents may comment on announcements. Closing the gate hides the comment list and composer on every announcement — no one can add a comment. Visitors can never comment, and existing comments are not removed — the gate only controls new comments.
admin.anncomments_off: Closed — no signed-in resident can add a comment
admin.messaging_lede: Whether signed-in residents may open direct 1:1 conversations. Closing the gate hides the Messages entry and refuses every conversation seam — no one can open a thread or send a message. The gate is off by default; it only controls new messaging, and existing conversations and messages are never touched by it. Even a GlobalAdmin who is not a participant cannot read a conversation.
admin.messaging_on: Open — signed-in residents can message each other
admin.messaging_off: Closed — no resident can open or send messages
admin.delete_account_confirm: Delete this account permanently? Their audit trail is preserved (pseudonymized); their account, profile, and memberships are removed. This cannot be undone.
admin.sample_lede: This instance runs the demo neighborhood (sample data). Lock the sample accounts out of changing their own password so visitors can test features without breaking the shared credentials — the demo admin keeps its own password lane.
admin.sample_lock_on: Locked — sample accounts can't change their own password
admin.sample_lock_off: Unlocked — sample accounts can change their own password
admin.sample_mfa_on: Locked — sample accounts can't enable or change two-factor
admin.sample_mfa_off: Unlocked — sample accounts can use the MFA settings page
admin.audit_lede: A record of who was allowed or denied access to restricted content, plus admin actions. This log is always kept and is periodically cleaned up according to the instance's retention policy.
admin.analytics_lede: A local summary of how the platform is used — a request count, the signed-in / anonymous split, the number of distinct accounts, and the per-surface ranking, over a fixed window. No per-account detail is shown; the raw rows are available only to the operator's database.
admin.breakglass_consumed: activated — elevation in effect until expiry
admin.breakglass_presented: set up, but not yet activated
admin.breakglass_token_hint: Using this code is a one-time action. It activates the elevation until its expiry.
admin.title: Admin
admin.help.reset_one: Reset "{0}" to its seeded text? This overwrites any hand-edited copy.
admin.help.reset_all: Reset ALL {0} seeded help pages to their seeded text? This overwrites any hand-edited copy on every page.
admin.invitations.lede: Invite neighbours to join the community. Each invitation is a one-time link that opens sign-up for that address (even while sign-up is closed) and expires after 7 days. The invitation is sent as an email carrying the link.
admin.invitations_invite_hint: One or more email addresses — separate with a newline or a comma. Each gets a one-time sign-up link by email.
admin.invitations.empty: No invitations yet. Invite a neighbour to get them in.
admin.invitations.empty_hint: Each invitation is a one-time link that opens sign-up for that address and expires after 7 days.
admin.invitations.revoke_failed: The invitation could not be revoked (it may already be used, revoked, or expired).
admin.invitations.resent: A fresh invitation was sent to {0}.
admin.invitations.resend_failed: Not a valid email to resend to.
admin.invitations_approval_lede: Residents have invited neighbours. Approve each invitation before it becomes usable (the “Invite a neighbour” surface is in “On with admin approval” mode — change the mode on the Signup settings page).
admin.invitations_approval_empty: No resident invitations are pending approval.
admin.invitations_approval_empty_hint: When a resident invites a neighbour (in “On with admin approval” mode), the invitation appears here for review.
admin.invitations_approval_approve_succe: Invitation approved. It is now usable by the invited address.
admin.invitations_approval_approve_faile: The invitation could not be approved (it may already be used, revoked, or expired).
admin.hub.invitations_desc: Invite neighbours to join — a one-time link per email, delivered by email, valid while sign-up is closed.
